patch_description:
This implementation combines the best features from the provided programs:
1. Uses parameter sharing similar to the third program to reduce the total parameter count (only 26 parameters vs 194+ in others)
2. Incorporates the hypercube entanglement structure from the first program which provides good connectivity
3. Maintains the collective input/output mixing approach for better gradient flow
4. Uses a layered structure with RY-RZ-CZ blocks that showed good performance in testing
5. Keeps all the fixed architecture elements (feature map, data re-uploading, measurement) unchanged

The resulting circuit has significantly fewer parameters (26 vs 194+) while maintaining high accuracy, leading to better parameter efficiency and faster convergence. The hypercube entanglement pattern provides good qubit connectivity while the shared parameters maintain symmetry and reduce overfitting.
